title: Expose safe mismatch details for refused runtime observation scopes
outcome: An existing supported host diagnostic or refusal notice identifies why a runtime closing scope no longer matches, without opening the store or exposing private payloads.
acceptance: A supported read-only diagnostic reports a fixed mismatch category and the relevant safe pinned/current revision, fence or root-generation facts for a refused runtime observation scope.
Behavioral coverage verifies that the reported reason distinguishes a work-revision mismatch from other scope changes and excludes credentials, full source_id payloads and private error prose.
